steps.title: Batch filenames including a leading dash
steps.command:
mkdir batch
cd batch
xargs -a ../input/xarg_task.txt -d '\n' -t touch --
xargs -a ../input/xarg_task.txt -d '\n' -t chmod 400 --
find . -type f -printf '%m %f\n' | sort
steps.stderr:
touch -- audit_report.txt backup_config.cfg evidence_notes.txt incident_log.txt -security_check.txt
chmod 400 -- audit_report.txt backup_config.cfg evidence_notes.txt incident_log.txt -security_check.txt

steps.title: Null-delimited filenames

mkdir edge
printf 'example\n' > 'edge/file with spaces.txt'

steps.title: Local HTTP request and user agent
steps.command: curl --fail --silent --show-error --noproxy '*' -A juzztesting 'http://127.0.0.1:'"$LAB_PORT"'/sample.txt'
steps.stdout: Linux CLI Lab local transfer fixture

steps.title: Local upload and response status
steps.command: curl --fail --silent --show-error --noproxy '*' -T server/sample.txt -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' 'http://127.0.0.1:'"$LAB_PORT"'/upload.txt'

steps.title: Wget log and exact transfer check
steps.command:
wget --no-proxy --append-output=download.log --limit-rate=125000 --timeout=5 --tries=1 -O downloaded.txt 'http://127.0.0.1:'"$LAB_PORT"'/sample.txt'
cmp downloaded.txt server/sample.txt
printf 'download bytes verified\n'
wc -c < downloaded.txt

steps.title: Wget timestamp-aware refresh
steps.command:
mkdir refresh
cd refresh
wget --no-proxy --timestamping --timeout=5 --tries=1 'http://127.0.0.1:'"$LAB_PORT"'/sample.txt' 2> first.log
wget --no-proxy --timestamping --timeout=5 --tries=1 'http://127.0.0.1:'"$LAB_PORT"'/sample.txt' 2> second.log
cmp sample.txt ../server/sample.txt
printf 'timestamp refresh bytes verified\n'

steps.title: Hex slice from offset 0x0a
steps.command: xxd -l 50 -s 0x0a input/xxd_task.txt

steps.title: Three groups of three octets
steps.command: xxd -c 9 -g 3 -l 36 input/xxd_task.txt

steps.title: Flag extraction and byte round-trip
steps.command:
grep -o 'flag{[^}]*}' input/xxd_task.txt
xxd -p input/xxd_task.txt | xxd -r -p > restored.txt
cmp restored.txt input/xxd_task.txt
printf 'byte round-trip verified\n'
